system.description:
You have 6 [inventory slots].

You gain [Reduction (Props, Gimmicks): 10] at the start of the scene.

By connecting the contents to a number of different spaces, this bag boasts a capacity that is unimaginable from its appearance. By expanding the distortion of space to the outside, it is also possible to deflect damage from traps.

Mysterious fur [core material] (80G) + Different dimension bag (beginner) (90G) + [Magic Catalyst 5] (40G) x 5 + Crafting Cost (200G)
